title: Open Humanities Journal: website software
description: A portable open-source website for The Human Question: author guidance, email submissions, house-style resources and an open-access PDF archive. No database or author accounts required. This deposit preserves a dated source snapshot of the implementation and documentation, with the limitations stated in the repository.
notes: This DOI identifies the website SOFTWARE archive, not a journal issue or individual article. MIT applies only to original software. Bundled journal articles remain credited to their respective authors under their separately stated CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 terms; journal branding is not licensed by the software licence. Article DOI registration is separate. Archival publication does not establish peer review, independent validation or production readiness.
